DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTRESTRICTIONS FORT TRYON JEWISH CENTER INC.(A/K/A FORT TRYON JEWISH CENTER - TEMPLE BETH SHOLOM), a New York religious corporation, having an address at524FortWashingtonAvenue,NewYork,NewYork10033 andFORTTRYON TOWERS, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 16 Chittenden Avenue, New York, New York 10033 (constituting the "parties in interest" as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961,as amended from time to time (the "Zoning Resolution"), as certified in a Certification made on October Z7 , 2005 by First American Title Insurance Co., LLC, a copy of which is attached as Schedule I hereto excepting those parties which have waived in writing their respective rights to join herein, if any, whose waivers are annexed hereto as Schedule I), with respect to the land located in Block 2180,Tax Lots 27,62and 64 of the TaxMap of the City of NewYork,County ofNewYork (such lots being contiguous for more than ten (10) linear feet along common boundary lines and located within a single block),for good and valuable consideration and with intent to bind all persons in whom such land is or shall hereafter be vested, do hereby declare that the tracts of landwhichareknownas andbythestreet addresses (i)524Ft.WashingtonAvenue,NewYork, New York (being the premises covered by Tax Lot 27 and more particularly described in Schedule Il hereto); (i) 31 Overlook Terrace, New York, New York (being the premises covered by Tax Lot 62 and more particularly described in Schedule IV hereto); and (i) 29 Overlook Terrace, New York, New York (being the premises covered by Tax Lot 64 and more particularly described in Schedule V hereto) are to be treated as one zoning lot for the purposes of and in accordance with the provisions of the Zoning Resolution. No breach by the declarants of this Declaration or of any agreement ancillary hereto shall affect the treatment of the tracts of land covered by this Declaration as one zoning lot, and such tracts of land shall continue to be treated as one zoning lot. This Declaration is a covenant running with the lands covered by this Declaration and shall bind and inure to thebenefit oftheheirs,executors,administrators,permitted successors and assigns of the declarants herein and every party now or hereafter acquiring any right, title or interest in said lands or in any part thereof.
